name: Vibration and haptics
plain: Lets the app vibrate the phone.
meaning: A harmless-looking motor trigger; no sensitive data. Android requires a manifest permission; iOS needs none.

android.note: Not required for haptic feedback via View.performHapticFeedback.

limits.headline: Can make the phone buzz, with no prompt and no personal data
limits.user_action: Nothing. It happens when the app gives feedback, like a tap or an alert
can: Play tap style feedback through the Taptic engine (iPhone)
Use a haptic pattern on Android 8 and later
cannot: Work on devices without the vibration motor
Ask you first; Android grants it at install and iPhone needs nothing
limits.differs: Android needs a manifest permission, granted at install; iPhone needs none.

story.what_it_is: Lets the app make the phone buzz.

marketing.name: Core Haptics
marketing.pitch: Add custom touch feedback with the phone's taptic engine.

marketing.name: Haptics on Android
marketing.pitch: Design touch feedback that feels natural on Android.

story.for_you: Your phone buzzes when a message comes in, a button clicks or a game explosion goes off. You rarely see a prompt, since it reads nothing about you.
story.for_makers: Touch feedback makes apps feel solid and guides eyes away from the screen. It is used in games, maps and alerts. It carries no personal data, but it can annoy people and drain the battery.

use_cases.example: A racing game rumbles when you hit a wall and a shooter thumps with each shot.
A map buzzes in a pattern for left and right turns.
A chat app taps you for a new message and a heart reaction.
A music app syncs buzzes to a drum beat.
A blind user feels different patterns for each type of alert.
A running app buzzes at each mile.
A payment confirmation gives a gentle click so you know it went through.

story.android_note: Android needs a manifest permission for the vibrate call, but not for haptic feedback on views.
story.ios_note: iPhone uses the taptic engine and the result depends on the hardware.

technical_bounds: Background vibration is limited to notifications and foreground services
Android 13 can silence vibration when media haptics are off

history.change: Haptic composition primitives and haptic coupled audio
